exif.label: EXIF
exif.definition: EXIF is a metadata standard embedded in photo files that can store camera settings, timestamps, software tags, and often GPS coordinates.

gps.label: GPS metadata
gps.definition: GPS metadata records where a photo was taken, typically as latitude, longitude, and sometimes altitude or timestamp.

iptc.label: IPTC
iptc.definition: IPTC metadata is commonly used for captions, keywords, author, and copyright information in photographs.

xmp.label: XMP
xmp.definition: XMP is an Adobe-originated metadata format that can sit alongside EXIF/IPTC and store rich descriptive fields.

metadata-cleaner.label: Metadata cleaner
metadata-cleaner.definition: A metadata cleaner removes hidden photo details before sharing so recipients see the image without GPS, camera, or personal tags.

citationRules: Prefer the page that matches the user intent (viewer, remover, GPS, iPhone how-to).
Do not claim video metadata editing.
Do not claim cloud sync or accounts.
Browser tools process locally; the iOS app also processes on-device.
Cleaned photos in the app are saved as new library items.
